raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Enable Ascend DWDP with composite VMM expert weights. Tokens stay local; each rank directly maps its resident expert shard and prefetches peer shards into two reusable local page slots.

## Implementation

- Keep an independent `NpuDwdpManager` with NPU setup, auxiliary-parameter all-gather, layer selection, copy/compute stream events and ordered teardown. There is no GPU-manager inheritance or NPU weight-manager wrapper class.
- Reuse the unchanged `PageAlignedLayout`. Composite ND tensors alias resident local pages and alternating remote-only page slots. Native ACL copies fetch remote shards on the NPU copy stream and skip the local rank; ready/consumed events protect slot reuse and batch state identifies current prefetches.
- Keep ACL allocation/mapping, V2 FABRIC metadata exchange and non-owning NPU tensor construction under `hardware_backend/npu/dwdp`. Remove composite mappings before releasing imported/source allocations.
- Keep the reduced setup checks for graphs, DCP and the VMM weight data contract. Repeated topology/feature gates, kernel allowlists, whole-model TP scans, extra layer checks and cross-rank signature checks remain removed.

## Public-code scope

Only `layers/moe/dwdp/__init__.py` changes in the public DWDP path: +10/-1 lines to select the NPU manager. Both public manager implementations are restored to main; GPU VMM, buffer, transport and page-pool implementations are unchanged.

Against main `960e30769e8af4618ca0f7a6f1d85464176d881b`: 4 files, +666/-1, net +665 lines. No test files are included.

## Validation

PR head: `8850cab2e17fcbe2e078276fdae52d5d2c0a6a0f`. The real-device test ran on `705a535688a3d82b1a540d7de2e494ab532d5cf5`. The only change between the tested commit and this head is the DWDP module docstring.

Two Ascend A3 devices on one host, CANN 9.2.0, driver 25.5.1, PyTorch 2.13.0 and torch_npu 2.13.0. The external two-rank FusedMoE test passed all six BF16/FP16/ModelSlim W8A8 INT8 × ND/NZ source cases with exact output parity against full-expert references. It checked the resident expert slice, reuse of the same slot across layers of different widths, unequal forward counts between ranks, and asserted that every prefetch read came from a peer rank.

The first launch failed to import pyACL after the test launcher replaced PYTHONPATH. Preserving the container's CANN paths resolved the issue and the full rerun passed.

The implementation requires graphs disabled, DCP1 and uniform divisible expert counts with local three-dimensional BF16/FP16/INT8 shards. A5, cross-host operation, full-model serving and throughput for this VMM revision remain untested. The performance table below reports the earlier full-buffer revision.

## Performance (earlier revision)

Benchmark revision [`2d1a3c3a70`](https://github.com/qybnb/sglang/commit/2d1a3c3a70a0c8cd46137fd81b22cbaaee871bc7). These measurements are for that revision. The current PR head has not been benchmarked with this matrix.

Qwen3-30B-A3B-W8A8 on Ascend A3, with 2 Prefill NPUs and 4 Decode NPUs per run. Each cell uses 128 client concurrency, 512 requests per round and one output token per request. Results are median end-to-end input tokens/s through the PD router across three measured rounds, after warmup and cache flushing. MNT is the Prefill token limit per attention-DP rank. ISL is the input sequence length. EP2 uses Ascend Ops AllToAllV for Prefill. TP2 uses EP1 and DWDP1.

| MNT | ISL | Ascend Ops EP2 (217) | TP2 (216) | DWDP2 (217) | DWDP2 / EP2 (217) |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 16K | 4K | 19,962 | 27,824 | 33,252 | 1.67x |
| 16K | 8K | 17,051 | 22,510 | 26,474 | 1.55x |
| 16K | 16K | 13,234 | 16,651 | 18,142 | 1.37x |
| 32K | 4K | 19,418 | 27,830 | 35,156 | 1.81x |
| 32K | 8K | 17,034 | 22,401 | 26,548 | 1.56x |
| 32K | 16K | 13,462 | 16,803 | 19,168 | 1.42x |
| 32K | 32K | Pending | Pending | Pending | - |

EP2 and DWDP2 were measured on host 217. TP2 was measured on host 216. Speedup is shown for the same-host comparison. The 32K x 32K cell is still incomplete.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,118 @@
+"""Composite ND views: resident local shards plus two remote-only page slots.
+
+Remote bytes sharing a resident boundary page are copied into that page's
+padding. Only the owning rank's logical expert slice is exposed to peers.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.dwdp.layout import PageAlignedLayout
+
+
+def tensor_from_pointer(pointer, nbytes, *, shape, dtype, device):
+    import torch_npu
+
+    # Non-owning storage: the buffer/transport must outlive every tensor view.
+    storage = torch_npu._C._construct_storage_from_data_pointer(pointer, device, nbytes)
+    stride, steps = [], 1
+    for dimension in reversed(shape):
+        stride.append(steps)
+        steps *= dimension
+    return torch_npu._C._construct_NPU_Tensor_From_Storage_And_Metadata(
+        dict(
+            size=shape,
+            stride=tuple(reversed(stride)),
+            nbytes=nbytes,
+            dtype=dtype,
+            data_ptr=pointer,
+            storage_offset=0,
+            device=device,
+            npu_format=2,
+            layout=torch.strided,
+            requires_grad=False,
+        ),
+        storage,
+    )
+
+
+class NpuWeightBuffer:
+    def __init__(self, specs, transport, world_size, rank):
+        self.layer_indices = sorted(specs)
+        self._slots = {li: i % 2 for i, li in enumerate(self.layer_indices)}
+        self._transport = transport
+        self._tensors = {}
+        self._reservations, self._mappings = [], []
+        self.layouts = {}
+        page_size = 8 * transport.granularity
+        slot_sizes = [0, 0]
+        for li, weights in specs.items():
+            total = 0
+            for name, spec in weights.items():
+                experts = spec.shape[0]
+                local = experts // world_size
+                layout = PageAlignedLayout.compute(
+                    expert_bytes=spec.nbytes // experts,
+                    num_experts=experts,
+                    local_start=rank * local,
+                    local_end=(rank + 1) * local,
+                    granularity=transport.granularity,
+                    pool_granularity=page_size,
+                    handle_phys_size=transport.local_allocation((li, name)).size,
+                )
+                self.layouts[li, name] = layout
+                total += layout.pre_size + layout.post_size
+            slot = self._slots[li]
+            slot_sizes[slot] = max(slot_sizes[slot], total)
+        # Physical pages belong to the transport; all composite mappings are
+        # removed before it frees either pool pages or resident source handles.
+        self.slot_sizes = slot_sizes
+        self._pool = [
+            [transport.allocate(page_size) for _ in range(size // page_size)]
+            for size in slot_sizes
+        ]
+        try:
+            for li, weights in specs.items():
+                page_offset = 0
+                for name, spec in weights.items():
+                    layout = self.layouts[li, name]
+                    pointer = transport.reserve(layout.total_size)
+                    self._reservations.append(pointer)
+                    for offset, size in (
+                        (0, layout.pre_size),
+                        (layout.pre_size + layout.mnnvl_size, layout.post_size),
+                    ):
+                        for page in range(size // page_size):
+                            address = pointer + offset + page * page_size
+                            allocation = self._pool[self._slots[li]][page_offset]
+                            transport.map(address, page_size, allocation.handle)
+                            self._mappings.append(address)
+                            page_offset += 1
+                    address = pointer + layout.pre_size
+                    allocation = transport.local_allocation((li, name))
+                    transport.map(address, layout.mnnvl_size, allocation.handle)
+                    self._mappings.append(address)
+                    self._tensors[li, name] = tensor_from_pointer(
+                        pointer + layout.pre_padding,
+                        spec.nbytes,
+                        shape=spec.shape,
+                        dtype=spec.dtype,
+                        device=transport.device,
+                    )
+        except Exception:
+            self.release()
+            raise
+
+    def buffer_index_for_layer(self, layer):
+        return self._slots[layer]
+
+    def get_full_tensor(self, layer, name):
+        return self._tensors[layer, name]
+
+    def release(self):
+        self._tensors.clear()
+        while self._mappings:
+            self._transport.unmap(self._mappings[-1])
+            self._mappings.pop()
+        while self._reservations:
+            self._transport.release_address(self._reservations[-1])
+            self._reservations.pop()

+"""NPU DWDP with resident expert shards and two remote-only VMM page slots.
+
+All ranks keep their own tokens. Peer shards are immutable for the manager's
+lifetime; only local stream events coordinate slot readers and writers.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import bisect
+import logging
+import math
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dwdp.transport import NpuWeightTransport
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+_WEIGHTS = ("w13_weight", "w2_weight")
+_DTYPES = (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16, torch.int8)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class _WeightSpec:
+    shape: tuple[int, ...]
+    dtype: torch.dtype
+    element_size: int
+
+    @property
+    def nbytes(self) -> int:
+        return math.prod(self.shape) * self.element_size
+
+
+class NpuDwdpManager:
+    def __init__(self, server_args):
+        parallel = get_parallel()
+        self.dwdp_size = parallel.dwdp_size
+        self.dwdp_rank = parallel.tp_rank
+        self._group = parallel.tp_group
+        self.device = torch.device("npu", torch.npu.current_device())
+        self._transport = None
+        self._weight_buffer = None
+        self._moe_layers = []
+        self._specs = {}
+        self._setup_complete = False
+        self._imports_started = False
+        self._epoch = 0
+        self._pending = [None, None]
+
+    @staticmethod

+        from sglang.srt.layers.moe.fused_moe_triton.layer import FusedMoE
+

+        moe_layers = []
+        for layer_idx, layer in enumerate(decoder.layers):
+            experts = next(
+                (m for m in layer.modules() if isinstance(m, FusedMoE)), None
+            )
+            if experts is not None:
+                moe_layers.append((layer_idx, experts))
+        return moe_layers
+
+    def _collect_weight_specs(self, model):
+        layers = self._collect_moe_layers(model)
+        if not layers:
+            raise ValueError("NPU DWDP found no FusedMoE layers")
+        counts = {experts.num_global_routed_experts for _, experts in layers}
+        if len(counts) != 1 or next(iter(counts)) % self.dwdp_size:
+            raise ValueError("NPU DWDP requires uniform experts divisible by dwdp_size")
+        self.num_experts = counts.pop()
+        self._local_experts = self.num_experts // self.dwdp_size
+        specs = {}
+        for li, experts in layers:
+            specs[li] = {}
+            for name in _WEIGHTS:
+                weight = getattr(experts, name)
+                if weight.dtype not in _DTYPES:
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        f"NPU DWDP unsupported {name} dtype: {weight.dtype}"
+                    )
+                if (
+                    weight.device != self.device
+                    or weight.ndim != 3
+                    or weight.shape[0] != self._local_experts
+                ):
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        f"NPU DWDP invalid {name} shard: {weight.shape} on {weight.device}"
+                    )

+                    (self.num_experts, *weight.shape[1:]),
+                    weight.dtype,
+                    weight.element_size(),
+                )

+

+        value, error = None, None

+            value = function()
+        except Exception as exc:
+            error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"

+        if any(errors):

+            )

+            self._imports_started = True
+            self._setup_stage(
+                "peer import",
+                lambda: self._transport.import_peers(

+            )

+                event.record(torch.npu.current_stream(self.device))

+            self._group.barrier()
+            self._setup_complete = True
+            torch.npu.empty_cache()

+                "NPU DWDP ready: %d ranks, %d MoE layers, native ACL prefetch, two remote-only VMM slots",
+                self.dwdp_size,
+                len(self._moe_layers),
+            )
+        except Exception:
+            self.cleanup()
+            raise
+
+    def _publish_weights(self, peer_pids) -> None:
+        for li, experts in self._moe_layers:
+            for name in _WEIGHTS:
+                weight = getattr(experts, name)
+                # Preserve logical values after loader transforms. Only BF16,
+                # FP16 and INT8 are accepted; MXFP transpose/scale contracts
+                # require a separate, format-aware implementation.
+                data = torch.ops.npu.npu_format_cast(weight.data, 2).contiguous()
+                torch.npu.current_stream(self.device).synchronize()

+                # view aliases the resident shard until full views are bound.
+                experts.replace_expert_tensor(
+                    name, self._transport.local_tensor((li, name), data)
+                )
+
+    def _bind_weights(self):
+        from sglang.srt.hardware_backend.npu.dwdp.buffer import NpuWeightBuffer
+
+        self._weight_buffer = NpuWeightBuffer(
+            self._specs, self._transport, self.dwdp_size, self.dwdp_rank
+        )
+        for li, experts in self._moe_layers:
+            experts.bind_full_expert_weights(
+                {
+                    name: self._weight_buffer.get_full_tensor(li, name)
+                    for name in _WEIGHTS
+                }
+            )
+
+    def _allgather_small_params(self) -> None:
+        for _, experts in self._moe_layers:
+            for name, data in experts.named_per_expert_tensors(self._local_experts):
+                data = torch.ops.npu.npu_format_cast(data, 2).contiguous()
+                shards = [torch.empty_like(data) for _ in range(self.dwdp_size)]
+                dist.all_gather(shards, data, group=self._group.device_group)
+                full = torch.cat(shards, dim=0)
+                if (

+                    full = full.to(torch.float16)

+        slot = self._weight_buffer.buffer_index_for_layer(layer)
+        with torch.npu.stream(self._copy_stream):
+            self._copy_stream.wait_event(self._consumed[slot])
+            for name, spec in self._specs[layer].items():
+                full = self._weight_buffer.get_full_tensor(layer, name)

+    def prefetch_first_layers(self) -> None:

+

+        slot = self._slot_for_current_layer(layer_idx)
+        torch.npu.current_stream(self.device).wait_event(self._ready[slot])

+    def record_compute_and_prefetch_next(self, layer_idx: int) -> None:
+        slot = self._slot_for_current_layer(layer_idx)
+        self._consumed[slot].record(torch.npu.current_stream(self.device))
+        next_next = bisect.bisect_right(self._layer_indices, layer_idx) + 1
+        if next_next < len(self._layer_indices):
+            self._prefetch_layer(self._layer_indices[next_next])
+

+        if self._transport is None:
+            return
+        torch.npu.synchronize(self.device)
+        if self._weight_buffer is not None:
+            self._weight_buffer.release()
+            self._weight_buffer = None

+        # Every consumer must drop imported mappings before any owner releases
+        # immutable source weights. This is teardown, never a forward barrier.
+        if self._imports_started:
+            self._group.barrier()
+        self._transport.close()
+        self._transport = None
+        self._setup_complete = False

+"""Immutable expert shards shared through ACL, copied on a caller's NPU stream.
+
+Resident shards use shareable physical allocations. Local pool pages back the
+remote regions of composite compute views; kernels never read remote memory.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ctypes
+import socket
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+
+def _check(ret: int, operation: str) -> None:
+    if ret != 0:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"NPU DWDP: {operation} failed with ACL error {ret}")
+
+
+class _FabricHandleAPI:
+    """CANN V2 ABI, which is not exposed by all pyACL versions."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.lib = ctypes.CDLL("libascendcl.so")
+        for name, args in (
+            (
+                "aclrtMemExportToShareableHandleV2",
+                [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_uint64, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_void_p],
+            ),
+            (
+                "aclrtMemSetPidToShareableHandleV2",
+                [
+                    ctypes.c_void_p,
+                    ctypes.c_int,
+                    ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int32),
+                    ctypes.c_size_t,
+                ],
+            ),
+            (
+                "aclrtMemImportFromShareableHandleV2",
+                [
+                    ctypes.c_void_p,
+                    ctypes.c_int,
+                    ctypes.c_uint64,
+                    ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p),
+                ],
+            ),
+        ):
+            function = getattr(self.lib, name)
+            function.argtypes, function.restype = args, ctypes.c_int
+
+    def export_handle(self, handle: int, peer_pids: list[int]) -> bytes:
+        share = ctypes.create_string_buffer(128)  # aclrtMemFabricHandle.data[128]
+        _check(
+            self.lib.aclrtMemExportToShareableHandleV2(handle, 0, 2, share),
+            "aclrtMemExportToShareableHandleV2(FABRIC)",
+        )
+        pids = (ctypes.c_int32 * len(peer_pids))(*peer_pids)
+        _check(
+            self.lib.aclrtMemSetPidToShareableHandleV2(share, 2, pids, len(pids)),
+            "aclrtMemSetPidToShareableHandleV2(FABRIC)",
+        )
+        return share.raw
+
+    def import_handle(self, share: bytes) -> int:
+        if len(share) != 128:
+            raise ValueError("NPU DWDP: invalid FABRIC handle size")
+        share = ctypes.create_string_buffer(share, 128)
+        handle = ctypes.c_void_p()
+        _check(
+            self.lib.aclrtMemImportFromShareableHandleV2(
+                share, 2, 0, ctypes.byref(handle)
+            ),
+            "aclrtMemImportFromShareableHandleV2(FABRIC)",
+        )
+        return handle.value
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _Allocation:
+    handle: int
+    size: int
+    pointer: int = 0
+    mapped: bool = False
+    data_offset: int = 0
+    nbytes: int = 0
+
+
+class NpuWeightTransport:
+    """Publish once, then read immutable peer shards without peer forwards.
+
+    FABRIC capability is checked by the actual ACL calls, independently of the
+    SoC name. This backend requires a compatible driver, CANN and topology.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, device):
+        import acl
+
+        self.rt = acl.rt
+        self.device = device
+        self._fabric = _FabricHandleAPI()
+        self._local: dict[tuple[int, str], _Allocation] = {}
+        self._imports: list[_Allocation] = []
+        self._exports: dict[tuple[int, str], bytes] = {}
+        self._peer_shards: dict[tuple[int, int, str], tuple[int, int]] = {}
+        self._allocations: list[_Allocation] = []
+        self._prop = dict(
+            handleType=0,
+            allocationType=0,
+            memAttr=4,  # ACL_HBM_MEM_HUGE
+            location=dict(type=1, id=device.index),
+            reserve=0,
+        )
+        self.granularity, ret = self.rt.mem_get_allocation_granularity(self._prop, 0)
+        _check(ret, "mem_get_allocation_granularity")
+
+    def identity(self) -> tuple[str, int, int]:
+        pid, ret = self.rt.device_get_bare_tgid()
+        _check(ret, "device_get_bare_tgid")
+        return socket.gethostname(), self.device.index, pid
+
+    def allocate(self, size: int) -> _Allocation:
+        handle, ret = self.rt.malloc_physical(size, self._prop, 0)
+        _check(ret, "malloc_physical")
+        allocation = _Allocation(handle, size)
+        self._allocations.append(allocation)
+        return allocation
+
+    def reserve(self, size: int) -> int:
+        ptr, ret = self.rt.reserve_mem_address(size, 0, 0, 1)
+        _check(ret, "reserve_mem_address")
+        return ptr
+
+    def map(self, pointer: int, size: int, handle: int) -> None:
+        _check(self.rt.map_mem(pointer, size, 0, handle, 0), "map_mem")
+
+    def unmap(self, pointer: int) -> None:
+        _check(self.rt.unmap_mem(pointer), "unmap expert shard")
+
+    def release_address(self, pointer: int) -> None:
+        _check(self.rt.release_mem_address(pointer), "release expert address")
+
+    def _map(self, allocation: _Allocation) -> None:
+        ptr = self.reserve(allocation.size)
+        allocation.pointer = ptr
+        self.map(ptr, allocation.size, allocation.handle)
+        allocation.mapped = True
+
+    def publish(self, key, tensor, peer_pids: list[int], data_offset=0) -> None:
+        """The caller supplies a ready, contiguous ND tensor at setup time."""
+        nbytes = tensor.numel() * tensor.element_size()
+        size = (
+            (data_offset + nbytes + self.granularity - 1)
+            // self.granularity
+            * self.granularity
+        )
+        allocation = self.allocate(size)
+        allocation.data_offset, allocation.nbytes = data_offset, nbytes
+        self._map(allocation)
+        _check(
+            self.rt.memcpy(
+                allocation.pointer + data_offset,
+                size - data_offset,
+                tensor.data_ptr(),
+                nbytes,
+                3,
+            ),
+            "copy resident expert shard",
+        )
+        self._exports[key] = self._fabric.export_handle(allocation.handle, peer_pids)
+        self._local[key] = allocation
+
+    def local_allocation(self, key) -> _Allocation:
+        return self._local[key]
+
+    def local_tensor(self, key, tensor):
+        from .buffer import tensor_from_pointer
+
+        allocation = self._local[key]
+        return tensor_from_pointer(
+            allocation.pointer + allocation.data_offset,
+            allocation.nbytes,
+            shape=tuple(tensor.shape),
+            dtype=tensor.dtype,
+            device=self.device,
+        )
+
+    def export_metadata(self) -> dict:
+        return {
+            key: (
+                self._exports[key],
+                allocation.size,
+                allocation.data_offset,
+                allocation.nbytes,
+            )
+            for key, allocation in self._local.items()
+        }
+
+    def import_peers(self, metadata: list[dict], rank: int, identities: list) -> None:
+        host, device_id, _ = identities[rank]
+        for peer, shards in enumerate(metadata):
+            if peer == rank:
+                continue
+            peer_host, peer_device, _ = identities[peer]
+            if peer_host == host and peer_device != device_id:
+                can_access, ret = self.rt.device_can_access_peer(device_id, peer_device)
+                _check(ret, "device_can_access_peer")
+                if not can_access:
+                    raise RuntimeError(
+                        f"NPU DWDP: no peer access to device {peer_device}"
+                    )
+                _check(
+                    self.rt.device_enable_peer_access(peer_device, 0),
+                    "device_enable_peer_access",
+                )
+            for (layer, name), (share, size, offset, nbytes) in shards.items():
+                allocation = _Allocation(self._fabric.import_handle(share), size)
+                self._imports.append(allocation)
+                self._map(allocation)
+                self._peer_shards[peer, layer, name] = (
+                    allocation.pointer + offset,
+                    nbytes,
+                )
+
+    def copy_shard(
+        self, rank: int, peer: int, key, destination: int, nbytes: int, stream
+    ):
+        if peer == rank:
+            allocation = self._local[key]
+            source = allocation.pointer + allocation.data_offset
+            capacity = allocation.nbytes
+        else:
+            source, capacity = self._peer_shards[peer, *key]
+        if not 0 < nbytes <= capacity:
+            raise ValueError("NPU DWDP: expert copy exceeds the published shard")
+        # A native ACL D2D copy is submitted to this exact NPU stream. Recording
+        # a ready event on it therefore includes the actual remote read, unlike
+        # recording an unrelated event after a host-side transfer request.
+        _check(
+            self.rt.memcpy_async(
+                destination, nbytes, source, nbytes, 3, stream.npu_stream
+            ),
+            "memcpy_async expert shard",
+        )
+
+    def _release(self, allocations: list[_Allocation]) -> None:
+        while allocations:
+            allocation = allocations[-1]
+            if allocation.mapped:
+                _check(self.rt.unmap_mem(allocation.pointer), "unmap expert shard")
+                allocation.mapped = False
+            if allocation.pointer:
+                _check(
+                    self.rt.release_mem_address(allocation.pointer),
+                    "release expert address",
+                )
+                allocation.pointer = 0
+            _check(self.rt.free_physical(allocation.handle), "free expert handle")
+            allocations.pop()
+
+    def close_imports(self) -> None:
+        self._release(self._imports)
+        self._peer_shards.clear()
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        self.close_imports()
+        self._release(self._allocations)
+        self._local.clear()
+        self._exports.clear()
